يرتأس (form VIII)
# يُرْتَأَسُ (yurtaʔasu) /jur.ta.ʔa.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# يُرْتَأَسَ (yurtaʔasa) /jur.ta.ʔa.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# يُرْتَأَسْ (yurtaʔas) /jur.ta.ʔas/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
